summary: Completed testing of iteration 47 features: External Integration Usage Analytics section on API Key Analytics page. Backend endpoint GET /api/admin/integration-usage-analytics returns correct JSON with totals, per-integration stats, daily breakdown, top endpoints, error breakdown, and recent requests. Frontend displays all data correctly with collapsible section, stat cards, integration cards, charts, and logs. All 21 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint correctly aggregates data from api_request_logs collection
Per-integration stats include name, base_url, total_requests, successful, failed, avg_duration_ms, total_bytes, success_rate
Daily breakdown shows date, total, successful, failed, avg_duration_ms
Top endpoints show integration_name, endpoint_path, total, avg_duration_ms
Recent requests include timestamp, integration_name, endpoint_path, http_status, success, duration_ms
Frontend IntegrationUsageSection component correctly renders all data
Collapsible header shows total call count badge
StatCard components display Total Calls, Successful, Failed with correct colors
Integration cards show name, calls, avg latency, data transferred, success rate percentage, base URL
MiniBar chart renders Integration Calls Over Time with date range labels
Top Endpoints section shows endpoint paths with call counts and latency
Integration Errors section shows 'No errors recorded' when empty
Recent Integration Calls log shows timestamp, integration name, endpoint path, HTTP status badge (200/404), and latency
Days filter (7/14/30/90) affects both API key analytics AND integration usage analytics
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data in api_request_logs collection (7 calls to Grid Scan and another integration)
